claim: A finite contextual tolerance may be tested rather than assumed to be an equivalence; an executable controller may authorize one bounded tooth only when an earned equivalence proposal lowers frozen coface loss and every independent proof, engine, and negative-control gate passes.

root_contract.carrier: finite labeled addresses X_n for n=1..5
root_contract.raw_relation: every reflexive symmetric relation T on X_n; transitivity is a measured property, never an input axiom
root_contract.earned_equivalence: the least equivalence relation containing T, computed as undirected connected-component closure
root_contract.identity_ceiling: an earned equivalence is a provisional quotient relation only; it is not primitive identity, ontology admission, or a physical carrier

drive_contract.loss: L_D(pi)=the number of frozen demanded address pairs collapsed by equivalence presentation pi
drive_contract.positive_rule: authorize a tooth only when g_D>0
drive_contract.flat_rule: g_D=0 is HOLD, never narrative progress
drive_contract.entropy_wording: coface-loss gradient is the bounded drive observable; no Shannon, von Neumann, or thermodynamic entropy claim is made

mss_contract.candidate_set: all labeled equivalence relations containing the raw tolerance
mss_contract.selection: return the full nondominated antichain under the two explicit axes

required_queries: SAT(C): an equivalence containing the chain tolerance exists
UNSAT(C and not phi): transitivity forces the missing endpoint pair
UNSAT: a strict sub-equivalence of the proposed component closure can still contain the raw tolerance
SAT control: removing transitivity permits the endpoint pair to remain absent

engine_contract.julia: Graphs.jl exact connected-component closure plus independent n=1..5 census
engine_contract.jax: x64 batched exhaustive relation census and fixed-point closure
engine_contract.pytorch: PyTorch Geometric message-passing reachability closure plus independent drive/HOLD evaluation
engine_contract.z3_cvc5: independent symbolic equivalence, implication, minimality, and erased-transitivity queries
engine_contract.controller: closed-receipt comparison, source binding, mutation tests, and final code-only decision

negative_controls.drop_transitivity: must change the endpoint implication from UNSAT to SAT
negative_controls.force_universal_proposal: must HOLD on the positive-drive fixture
negative_controls.count_preserving_demand_scramble: must HOLD on the within-component demand

code_gates: G0 object card and preregistration validate before builders
G1 exact tolerance/equivalence census matches the frozen Bell-number boundary
G2 Julia, JAX, and PyTorch independently recover the same two fixture closures
G3 z3 and cvc5 both pass the four symbolic proof/control queries
G4 coface drive is reconstructed from frozen demand edges
G5 positive fixture commits exactly one tooth; flat/reverse/null/universal/scrambled controls HOLD
G6 MSS returns an explicit antichain and no hidden scalar winner
G7 no engine lane reads a peer result
G8 source hashes, runtime identity, classification, and claim ceiling are bound
G10 Lev executes only deterministic commands/evals; no model verdict can open the gate
blocked_consumers: physics, cosmology, biology, cognition, or consciousness claims
LLM or council verdict as a gate
